words.enDefinition: one part of a journey flown between two airports

examples.en: The first flight leg ended in Vancouver, where I met my friend before continuing east.
examples.zh: 第一段「航程」到温哥华结束，我在那里和朋友碰面后再继续往东。

examples.en: I saved my reading for the longest flight leg because it was in daylight.
examples.zh: 我留着书在最长的那段「航程」上看，因为那一段是白天飞。

words.enDefinition: a flight that reaches its destination without an intermediate stop

examples.en: I booked a nonstop flight so I could get back home before my evening class.
examples.zh: 我订了「不经停航班」，这样可以在夜课前到家。

examples.en: A nonstop flight made the trip shorter when I was travelling with my project group.
examples.zh: 和项目组一起出行时，「不经停航班」缩短了整段行程。

words.enDefinition: make contact with the ground at the end of a flight

examples.en: We were due to touch down just before my first lecture started back home.
examples.zh: 我们预计在我回去后的第一节课开始前「着陆」。

examples.en: The captain said we would touch down a little earlier than our original arrival time.
examples.zh: 机长说我们会比原定到达时间稍早「着陆」。

collocations: the plane will touch down soon

words.zhGloss: 用自家航班号销售的航司
words.enDefinition: an airline offering a flight under its own flight number
acceptedZhAnswers: 用自家航班号销售的航司

examples.en: The itinerary listed the marketing carrier beside the airline that would actually fly the plane.
examples.zh: 行程单把「用自家航班号销售的航司」列在实际执飞航司旁边。

examples.en: I compared the flight numbers to see whether the marketing carrier had changed on my booking.
examples.zh: 我对比了航班号码，看看预订里的「用自家航班号销售的航司」是否变了。

collocations: the marketing carrier for a codeshare flight

words.enDefinition: a spoken message played to passengers inside the aircraft

examples.en: A cabin announcement gave the arrival time while I was putting my book away.
examples.zh: 我正收起书时，「客舱广播」播报了到达时间。

examples.en: I missed the first cabin announcement because I was still wearing my headphones.
examples.zh: 我当时还戴着耳机，没听到第一条「客舱广播」。

words.enDefinition: the model or design of aircraft used for a flight

examples.en: The aircraft type changed, and the seat layout on my reservation looked different afterwards.
examples.zh: 「飞机机型」变了，后来我看到预订里的座位布局也不同了。

examples.en: I noticed the aircraft type on the itinerary while comparing two flights home for the break.
examples.zh: 我比较假期回家的两个航班时，注意到行程单写了「飞机机型」。

words.enDefinition: given permission by air traffic control to take off

examples.en: The captain said we were cleared for takeoff after a long wait on the ground.
examples.zh: 在地面等了很久后，机长说我们已经「获准起飞」。

examples.en: We were cleared for takeoff just as I finished reading the first chapter of my book.
examples.zh: 我刚读完书的第一章，飞机就「获准起飞」了。

words.enDefinition: the last part of the approach as the plane lines up for landing

examples.en: We were on final approach when I finally saw the river through the clouds.
examples.zh: 飞机进入「最后进近」时，我隔着云终于看到了那条河。

examples.en: The captain announced the final approach after we passed over the edge of the city.
examples.zh: 飞过城市边缘后，机长广播说飞机进入了「最后进近」。

words.enDefinition: the height at which a plane flies steadily along its route

examples.en: The plane reached cruising altitude while I was organizing notes for the next seminar.
examples.zh: 我在整理下次研讨课的笔记时，飞机到达了「巡航高度」。

examples.en: I could see the mountains clearly after we reached cruising altitude above the clouds.
examples.zh: 到云层上方的「巡航高度」以后，我能清楚地看见群山。

words.enDefinition: the part of a flight when the aircraft moves to a lower altitude

examples.en: We began our descent while I was reading the final page of my article.
examples.zh: 我读文章最后一页的时候，飞机开始「下降」。

examples.en: The pilot announced our descent, so I put the last of my books away.
examples.zh: 机长广播说飞机开始「下降」，我就把最后一本书收好了。

words.enDefinition: stay in your seat without standing up

examples.en: Please remain seated until the aircraft has come to a complete stop at the gate.
examples.zh: 飞机在登机口完全停稳前，「请留在座位上」。

examples.en: The crew asked us to remain seated while a few passengers collected their bags first.
examples.zh: 有几位乘客先取行李时，乘务组请我们「留在座位上」。

words.enDefinition: secure the belt that holds you in your seat

examples.en: Please fasten your seat belt while we prepare for landing at our destination airport.
examples.zh: 我们正在准备在目的地机场着陆，「请系好安全带」。

examples.en: Please fasten your seat belt while we wait for the weather to improve further.
examples.zh: 我们在等天气进一步好转，这段时间「请系好安全带」。

collocations: remember to fasten your seat belt
ask you to fasten your seat belt

words.enDefinition: the staff who look after passengers inside the aircraft

examples.en: The cabin crew answered questions about connections before we arrived at the next airport.
examples.zh: 到下一个机场前，「客舱乘务组」回答了转机方面的问题。

examples.en: I thanked the cabin crew for checking whether my headphones were still on the seat.
examples.zh: 我感谢「客舱乘务组」帮我查看耳机还在不在座位上。

collocations: a member of the cabin crew

words.enDefinition: a person who looks after passengers on an aircraft

examples.en: A flight attendant helped me read a small note on the in-flight entertainment screen.
examples.zh: 一位「客舱乘务员」帮我看机上娱乐屏幕上的一条小提示。

examples.en: I asked the flight attendant when the plane was expected to arrive in Toronto.
examples.zh: 我问「客舱乘务员」飞机预计什么时候到多伦多。

words.enDefinition: a small folding table for an aircraft passenger

examples.en: I lowered the tray table to look over my notes after the crew served drinks.
examples.zh: 乘务组送完饮料后，我放下了「座位折叠小桌板」，过了一遍笔记。

examples.en: My notebook slid across the tray table when the plane started to turn slightly.
examples.zh: 飞机稍微转弯时，我的笔记本在「座位折叠小桌板」上滑了一下。

collocations: put something on the tray table

words.enDefinition: a display built into the back of the seat in front

examples.en: The seatback screen showed our location while we were still flying above the coast.
examples.zh: 飞过海岸上空时，「前排椅背屏幕」显示了我们所在的位置。

examples.en: I used the seatback screen to check how much time was left in the flight.
examples.zh: 我用「前排椅背屏幕」看了离航班结束还有多长时间。

words.enDefinition: tilt the back of your seat farther back

examples.en: You can recline your seat a little once I've finished writing in my notebook.
examples.zh: 等我在本子上写完，你可以稍微「把座椅靠背向后调」。

examples.en: Would you mind waiting to recline your seat until the meal service is over?
examples.zh: 能等送餐结束后再「把座椅靠背向后调」吗？

collocations: ask if you can recline your seat

words.enDefinition: with a seat's back raised to its straight position

examples.en: Please make sure your seat is in the upright position as we prepare to land.
examples.zh: 我们正在准备着陆，请确认「座椅靠背已竖直」。

examples.en: I left my seat in the upright position while the person behind me ate lunch.
examples.zh: 后面的人在吃午饭时，我让「座椅靠背保持竖直」。

collocations: keep your seat in the upright position
a seat in the upright position
return it to the upright position

words.enDefinition: the part of a seat that supports your arm

examples.en: I kept my elbow off the armrest while my neighbour was writing a note.
examples.zh: 邻座在写东西时，我的手肘没有搭在「座椅扶手」上。

examples.en: The power outlet was just under the armrest between the two seats on our flight.
examples.zh: 我们那趟航班的电源口就在两个座位之间的「座椅扶手」下面。

collocations: rest an elbow on the armrest

words.enDefinition: a button that signals you want a flight attendant

examples.en: I asked which symbol marked the attendant call button above the row of seats.
examples.zh: 我问座位上方哪个图标代表「呼叫乘务员的按钮」。

examples.en: The attendant call button lit up when the passenger next to me pressed it.
examples.zh: 旁边的乘客按了「呼叫乘务员的按钮」，按钮就亮了。

words.enDefinition: films, music, or other entertainment provided during a flight

examples.en: I browsed the in-flight entertainment after finishing the reading I brought for class.
examples.zh: 看完上课要读的材料后，我浏览了一下「机上娱乐服务」。

examples.en: The in-flight entertainment included a short documentary about the city we were flying to.
examples.zh: 「机上娱乐服务」里有一部短纪录片，介绍我们要飞去的城市。

words.enDefinition: the period when crew serve meals to passengers on a flight

examples.en: I put my books away before meal service so there would be space on the table.
examples.zh: 「机上送餐服务」开始前，我把书收好，好在桌板上腾出地方。

examples.en: The captain said meal service would start after we passed through the clouds ahead.
examples.zh: 机长说飞过前面的云层后，就开始「机上送餐服务」。

words.enDefinition: a wheeled cart the crew uses to move meals through the cabin

examples.en: The meal trolley stopped next to my row while I was packing up my notebook.
examples.zh: 我收笔记本时，「机上餐车」停在我那排座位旁。

examples.en: I waited until the meal trolley had passed before asking to get into the aisle.
examples.zh: 我等「机上餐车」过去后，才开口请人让我到过道上。

collocations: a meal trolley in the aisle

words.enDefinition: irregular air movement that makes an aircraft shake or bump

examples.en: We felt some turbulence over the hills, and my pen rolled across the table.
examples.zh: 飞过丘陵时有点「飞行颠簸」，我的笔顺着桌板滚了过去。

examples.en: The crew paused the drinks service when the plane began to encounter turbulence.
examples.zh: 飞机开始出现「飞行颠簸」时，乘务组暂停了饮料服务。

words.enDefinition: a flight with little shaking or sudden movement

examples.en: It was a smooth flight, so I managed to read most of the required chapter.
examples.zh: 这趟「航班飞得平稳」，我读完了指定章节的大部分内容。

examples.en: My friend enjoyed a smooth flight for once and slept until we reached the coast.
examples.zh: 我朋友这次难得遇到「平稳的航班」，一直睡到我们飞抵海岸附近。

words.enDefinition: the lights used inside the passenger area of an aircraft

examples.en: The crew dimmed the cabin lighting after dinner while most of us settled down.
examples.zh: 晚饭后大多数人安顿下来时，乘务组调暗了「客舱照明」。

examples.en: I stopped reading when the cabin lighting changed and the screen became easier to see.
examples.zh: 「客舱照明」变了，屏幕更好看清，我就不看书了。

words.enDefinition: a pocket on the back of the seat in front

examples.en: I put the magazine in the seatback pocket while my tray was being cleared.
examples.zh: 乘务员收餐盘时，我把杂志放进了「前排椅背储物袋」。

examples.en: I checked the seatback pocket twice before getting off the plane after our group trip.
examples.zh: 小组旅行结束下飞机前，我检查了两遍「前排椅背储物袋」。

words.enDefinition: politely asks an attendant to bring a blanket

examples.en: Could I get a blanket after you finish serving the drinks to our row?
examples.zh: 给我们这排送完饮料后，「能给我一条毯子吗」？

examples.en: Could I get a blanket because the seat by the window feels quite cold?
examples.zh: 「能给我一条毯子吗」？靠窗的座位挺冷的。

collocations: could I get a blanket for this seat?
excuse me, could I get a blanket?
when you have a moment, could I get a blanket?

words.enDefinition: asks a nearby passenger to move so you can reach the aisle

examples.en: Could you let me out once you've put your drink down on the table?
examples.zh: 等你把饮料放到桌板上，「能让我从座位出去吗」？

examples.en: Excuse me, could you let me out after the trolley has passed our seats?
examples.zh: 不好意思，餐车经过我们这排后，「能让我从座位出去吗」？

collocations: could you let me out for a moment?
excuse me, could you let me out?
could you let me out when the trolley passes?

words.enDefinition: a cover used to block light from an aircraft window

examples.en: I raised the window shade to see the coast during the last hour of flight.
examples.zh: 航班最后一小时，我拉起「舷窗遮光板」，想看看海岸。

examples.en: My neighbour lowered the window shade while I was trying to read my notes.
examples.zh: 我在看笔记时，邻座拉下了「舷窗遮光板」。

words.enDefinition: electric power available from a socket or port at your seat

examples.en: I checked for in-seat power because my phone battery was low after the first flight.
examples.zh: 第一程航班后手机快没电了，我就查看有没有「座位电源」。

examples.en: The in-seat power worked, so I could read on my tablet until we landed.
examples.zh: 「座位电源」可以用，所以我用平板一直看到飞机着陆。

words.enDefinition: wireless internet access available while travelling on an aircraft

examples.en: I used in-flight Wi-Fi to tell my roommate which bus I hoped to catch.
examples.zh: 我用「机上无线网络」告诉室友我希望赶上哪班公交。

examples.en: The in-flight Wi-Fi stopped working while I was trying to open the course website.
examples.zh: 我正要打开课程网站时，「机上无线网络」断了。

words.enDefinition: a later flight that continues your journey after you change planes

examples.en: My connecting flight left from a different terminal, so I checked the route before landing.
examples.zh: 我的「转乘航班」从另一座航站楼出发，所以我着陆前就查了路线。

examples.en: A crew member showed me where to check the gate for my connecting flight.
examples.zh: 一位乘务员告诉我在哪里查「转乘航班」的登机口。

collocations: the gate for a connecting flight

words.enDefinition: a wait at an airport between two flights on a journey

examples.en: I spent my layover working on a presentation beside one of the charging points.
examples.zh: 在「转机等候时间」里，我坐在一个充电点旁边做汇报稿。

examples.en: The layover gave me enough time to call home before taking the next flight.
examples.zh: 「转机等候时间」够长，我赶下一趟航班前还给家里打了个电话。

words.enDefinition: a planned break in a journey at an intermediate place

examples.en: We planned a stopover in Singapore and spent two days with friends before continuing home.
examples.zh: 我们安排在新加坡「中途停留」，和朋友待了两天后再继续回家。

examples.en: I chose an itinerary with a stopover because I wanted to visit my former flatmate.
examples.zh: 我想见见以前的室友，所以选了一条能「中途停留」的行程。

collocations: spend a stopover in a city

words.enDefinition: a change of flights with very little time in between

examples.en: I had a tight connection and asked where my gate was before leaving the plane.
examples.zh: 我这次「转机时间紧」，下飞机前就问了登机口在哪儿。

examples.en: The tight connection left me little time to stop for a snack at the airport.
examples.zh: 这个「时间紧的转机」几乎没给我留时间在机场买点吃的。

words.enDefinition: the official shortest scheduled interval for transferring between particular flights

examples.en: The agent checked the minimum connection time for the airport before showing me another itinerary.
examples.zh: 工作人员先查了那个机场的「最短转机时间」，才给我看另一条行程。

examples.en: I asked what minimum connection time applied to the transfer listed on my ticket.
examples.zh: 我问机票上的这次转机适用哪个「最短转机时间」。

words.enDefinition: a change between flights included on one ticket

examples.en: I chose a same-ticket connection so both flights would appear under one ticket number.
examples.zh: 我选了「同一张机票上的转机」，这样两趟航班都用一个机票号码。

examples.en: The agent confirmed that the route included a same-ticket connection at the first airport.
examples.zh: 工作人员确认，这条路线在第一个机场有「同一张机票上的转机」。

collocations: a same-ticket connection through a hub

words.enDefinition: individual tickets bought separately for different parts of a trip

examples.en: I booked separate tickets because my friend was only joining me for the second flight.
examples.zh: 我这两段机票是「分开买的」，因为我朋友只和我一起乘第二趟航班。

examples.en: The two flights were on separate tickets, so I had two different booking references.
examples.zh: 两趟航班用的是「分开买的机票」，所以我有两个不同的预订编号。

words.enDefinition: a transfer between flights that the traveler arranges independently

examples.en: The itinerary said self-transfer, so I asked what the change at that airport involved.
examples.zh: 行程单写着「自行转机」，所以我问了在那个机场换乘具体要做什么。

examples.en: I chose a self-transfer because I wanted to book the second leg at a different time.
examples.zh: 我想把第二段航程订在另一个时间，所以选了「自行转机」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer between flights while staying within the airport's restricted area

examples.en: The signs for the airside transfer led us towards a bus between the terminals.
examples.zh: 「机场管制区内转机」的路牌指向了往返两座航站楼的巴士。

examples.en: I asked whether an airside transfer was possible for the flights in my booking.
examples.zh: 我问我订的这几个航班能不能「在机场管制区内转机」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer that passes through the public side of an airport

examples.en: The agent marked the landside transfer on the map and pointed out the public walkway.
examples.zh: 工作人员在地图上标出了「经机场公共区转机」的路线，并指出了公共步道。

examples.en: I had a landside transfer and met my friend briefly in the public arrivals hall.
examples.zh: 我这次是「经机场公共区转机」，就在公共到达大厅和朋友短暂见了面。

words.enDefinition: a move between different airport terminals during a journey

examples.en: I checked how long the terminal transfer would take before I showed my friend the tickets.
examples.zh: 把机票给朋友看之前，我查了「航站楼之间换乘」要多久。

examples.en: One airport map showed our terminal transfer as a short walk through a covered passage.
examples.zh: 一张机场地图显示，我们这段「航站楼之间换乘」只要走过一小段有顶通道。

collocations: follow signs for a terminal transfer
allow time for a terminal transfer

words.enDefinition: a small transport service carrying passengers between airport transfer points

examples.en: I took the transfer shuttle after checking which terminal my next flight would leave from.
examples.zh: 查清下一趟航班从哪座航站楼出发后，我坐了「机场转乘接驳车」。

examples.en: We waited for the transfer shuttle beside a sign showing the other terminal numbers.
examples.zh: 我们在写着其他航站楼编号的牌子旁等「机场转乘接驳车」。

words.enDefinition: an airport desk where staff help with changes between flights

examples.en: I went to the transfer desk because my onward flight had disappeared from the app.
examples.zh: 我的下一趟航班在应用里不见了，我就去了「转机服务柜台」。

examples.en: The agent at the transfer desk showed me where to check for my new gate.
examples.zh: 「转机服务柜台」的工作人员告诉我在哪儿查新的登机口。

collocations: an agent at the transfer desk

words.enDefinition: a sign or label directing passengers to their next flight

examples.en: We followed the flight connections signs because our next flight left from another terminal.
examples.zh: 下一趟航班从另一座航站楼出发，所以我们跟着「航班转机指示」走。

examples.en: The sign marked 'Flight Connections' pointed towards a corridor where passengers were waiting.
examples.zh: 写着「航班转机」的牌子指向一条走廊，有些旅客正在里面等。

words.enDefinition: a passenger who passes through an airport on the way elsewhere

examples.en: As a transit passenger, I stayed at the airport until my second flight was called.
examples.zh: 作为「过境乘客」，我一直待在机场，直到广播通知第二趟航班。

examples.en: The transit passenger asked which signs led to the gate for her next flight.
examples.zh: 这位「过境乘客」问跟着哪些指示牌能走到下一趟航班的登机口。

words.enDefinition: an airport area for passengers waiting to continue their journeys

examples.en: I found a quiet place in the transit area to finish reading my assignment.
examples.zh: 我在「转机候机区」找了个安静的地方，把作业要求看完。

examples.en: The café in the transit area was still open when we landed after midnight.
examples.zh: 我们过了午夜才着陆，「转机候机区」的咖啡馆还开着。

words.enDefinition: pass another security check while making a connection

examples.en: I asked whether I needed to go through security again before my connecting flight.
examples.zh: 我问上转乘航班之前是否要「再过一次安检」。

examples.en: We had to go through security again after changing airports for the second flight.
examples.zh: 为了第二趟航班换机场后，我们得「再过一次安检」。

collocations: ask whether to go through security again
need to go through security again
go through security again for a connection

words.enDefinition: pick up a checked bag and hand it in for the next flight

examples.en: I asked where to collect and recheck my bag before heading to the next terminal.
examples.zh: 去下一座航站楼前，我问了在哪儿「领回行李再办理托运」。

examples.en: I had to collect and recheck my bag during the connection shown on my itinerary.
examples.zh: 这次行程单上的转机，我得「领回行李再办理托运」。

collocations: need to collect and recheck my bag
where to collect and recheck my bag
time to collect and recheck my bag

words.enDefinition: used for baggage accepted for transfer to a named airport

examples.en: The bag label showed that my suitcase was checked through to the final airport.
examples.zh: 行李标签显示，我的箱子已「直挂至最终到达的机场」。

examples.en: I asked whether our bags were checked through to Boston or just to the transfer airport.
examples.zh: 我问我们的行李是「直挂至波士顿」，还是只托运到转机机场。

collocations: bags checked through to the final destination
luggage checked through to the next airport
ask if it is checked through to the end

words.enDefinition: a counter where passengers hand in bags collected during a transfer

examples.en: The agent pointed out the baggage recheck counter on the map of the arrivals level.
examples.zh: 工作人员在到达层的地图上指出了「行李转机再托运柜台」。

examples.en: We reached the baggage recheck counter after collecting our bags for this particular connection.
examples.zh: 这个换乘环节我们先领了行李，再走到「行李转机再托运柜台」。

collocations: go to the baggage recheck counter
ask at the baggage recheck counter
follow signs to the baggage recheck counter

words.enDefinition: the part of a trip travelling towards the destination

examples.en: I booked the outbound leg first because our field trip had a fixed start date.
examples.zh: 实地考察的开始日期已经定了，所以我先订了「去程」。

examples.en: The outbound leg took us through a different airport from the journey home afterwards.
examples.zh: 「去程」途经的机场和后来回家的路上不一样。

collocations: the outbound leg of a journey

words.enDefinition: a change of flights within one airport terminal

examples.en: I booked a same-terminal connection because my first flight was scheduled to arrive after dark.
examples.zh: 第一趟航班预计天黑后才到，所以我订了「同一航站楼内转机」的行程。

examples.en: The agent found a same-terminal connection that left us more time between the flights.
examples.zh: 工作人员找到了「同一航站楼内转机」的行程，两趟航班之间留给我们的时间也更多。

words.enDefinition: a switch to a different airport between flights on one journey

examples.en: The itinerary included an airport change, so we checked how far apart the airports were.
examples.zh: 这份行程需要「转机途中更换机场」，所以我们查了两个机场相距多远。

examples.en: I avoided an airport change because I wanted to keep the entire trip simple.
examples.zh: 我想让行程简单一点，所以避开了「转机途中更换机场」的路线。

collocations: an itinerary with an airport change
allow time for an airport change

words.enDefinition: a wait between flights that lasts overnight

examples.en: I had an overnight layover and booked a small room near the airport.
examples.zh: 我的「转机等候要过夜」，就在机场附近订了一间小房间。

examples.en: We packed snacks for the overnight layover because the next flight left early in the morning.
examples.zh: 下一趟航班清早出发，所以我们给「过夜转机等候」准备了零食。

words.enDefinition: asks whether there will be enough time to board the next flight

examples.en: Will I make my connection if we arrive twenty minutes later than the original estimate?
examples.zh: 要是比原先预计的晚二十分钟到，「我还赶得上转机吗」？

examples.en: If I have to change terminals, will I make my connection with this arrival time?
examples.zh: 如果还得换航站楼，按这个时间到，「我还赶得上转机吗」？

collocations: will I make my connection at this rate?
will I make my connection if we land late?
given the delay, will I make my connection?

words.enDefinition: says a passenger may miss the next flight because time is short

examples.en: The later arrival put my connection at risk, and the agent was checking alternatives.
examples.zh: 到得晚了，我「可能赶不上转机」，工作人员正在查备选航班。

examples.en: A message said 'Connection at risk' after the aircraft had been held on the ground.
examples.zh: 飞机在地面等了一阵后，一条消息提示「可能赶不上转机」。

collocations: a connection at risk after a delay
a delay putting a connection at risk

words.enDefinition: allow travelers with another flight to leave the aircraft before others

examples.en: The crew asked us to let connecting passengers off first after our late arrival.
examples.zh: 我们晚到以后，乘务组请大家「让转机旅客先下机」。

examples.en: We stayed seated to let connecting passengers off first while the crew opened the door.
examples.zh: 乘务组开门时，我们留在座位上，「让转机旅客先下机」。

collocations: ask us to let connecting passengers off first
agree to let connecting passengers off first
an appeal to let connecting passengers off first

words.enDefinition: the movement of checked baggage from one flight to another

examples.en: The supervisor checked the baggage transfer before telling me where the suitcase would come out.
examples.zh: 主管查了「转机行李转运」的安排，才告诉我箱子会从哪儿出来。

examples.en: I asked whether a baggage transfer had been arranged for the two flights on my ticket.
examples.zh: 我问这张机票上的两趟航班之间是否安排了「转机行李转运」。

words.enDefinition: a flight arriving at the airport being discussed

examples.en: The inbound flight to our transfer airport arrived a few minutes earlier than planned.
examples.zh: 「飞抵转机机场的航班」比计划早了几分钟到。

examples.en: I checked the inbound flight while my friend waited in the arrivals hall for me.
examples.zh: 朋友在到达大厅等我时，我查看了「飞抵该机场的航班」。

collocations: an inbound flight from a city

words.enDefinition: change flights at a specified airport or city on the way

examples.en: We decided to connect via Dublin because the two flights fit our class schedule better.
examples.zh: 这两趟航班更适合我们的课表，所以我们决定「经都柏林转机」。

examples.en: I can connect via the same airport on my way back, depending on the times.
examples.zh: 看时间是否合适，我回来也可以「经同一个机场转机」。

collocations: choose to connect via a hub

words.enDefinition: a flight leaving or arriving later than scheduled

examples.en: The flight delay meant I could join the first hour of our group call.
examples.zh: 「航班延误」了，我就能参加小组通话的第一个小时。

examples.en: I told my housemate about the flight delay before she left for the airport.
examples.zh: 我在室友出发去机场之前，告诉了她「航班延误」的事。

collocations: a flight delay due to weather

words.enDefinition: the decision that a scheduled flight will not take place

examples.en: The airline sent a flight cancellation notice while we were still waiting for the train.
examples.zh: 我们还在等火车时，航空公司就发来了「航班取消」通知。

examples.en: We changed our travel plans after the flight cancellation and arrived the following morning.
examples.zh: 「航班取消」后我们改了出行计划，第二天早上到达。

words.enDefinition: a flight sent to land at an airport other than the planned one

examples.en: The diverted flight landed in another city and we waited there for an update.
examples.zh: 「改降其他机场的航班」落地在另一座城市，我们在那里等消息。

examples.en: I tracked the diverted flight after my friend told me the plane had changed course.
examples.zh: 朋友告诉我飞机改了航向后，我追踪了这个「改降其他机场的航班」。

collocations: a diverted flight due to weather

words.enDefinition: the airline's replacement of the plane assigned to a flight

examples.en: The airline announced an aircraft change, then posted a revised seating plan in the app.
examples.zh: 航空公司宣布「更换执飞飞机」，随后在应用里公布了新的座位图。

examples.en: I noticed the aircraft change because my window seat was now in another row.
examples.zh: 我发现「执飞飞机换了」，因为靠窗座位挪到了另一排。

collocations: notify passengers of an aircraft change

words.enDefinition: a change to the gate assigned for a flight

examples.en: A gate change sent us to the other side of the terminal before boarding.
examples.zh: 因为「登机口变更」，登机前我们去了航站楼另一头。

examples.en: I saw the gate change on my phone while waiting for a coffee near departures.
examples.zh: 我在出发区附近等咖啡时，手机显示了「登机口变更」。

words.enDefinition: a delay caused by weather affecting travel

examples.en: The weather delay gave me another hour to finish my reading before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 「天气原因延误」让我离校前又多出一个小时，可以把要读的材料看完。

examples.en: The pilot announced a weather delay because a storm was passing near our destination.
examples.zh: 目的地附近有暴风雨经过，飞行员广播说会「因天气延误」。

collocations: a weather delay at the destination

words.enDefinition: a delay while an equipment issue is checked or resolved

examples.en: A technical delay kept the plane at the gate while the crew waited for an update.
examples.zh: 飞机「因技术原因延误」，一直停在登机口，机组正在等消息。

examples.en: The airline posted another estimate after announcing a technical delay on the evening flight.
examples.zh: 航空公司宣布夜间航班「因技术原因延误」后，又公布了一个预计出发时间。

words.enDefinition: a plane arriving late before it is due to operate another flight

examples.en: The airline cited a late inbound aircraft when it delayed our evening departure again.
examples.zh: 航空公司再次推迟了我们晚上出发的时间，说是因为「前序执飞飞机晚到」。

examples.en: We waited for a late inbound aircraft, then watched our plane arrive at the gate.
examples.zh: 我们等着「晚到的前序执飞飞机」，后来看到它停靠在登机口。

collocations: a delay due to a late inbound aircraft
wait for a late inbound aircraft
a late inbound aircraft from another city

words.enDefinition: a wait before takeoff while a flight is held on the ground

examples.en: We had a ground delay before takeoff, and I finished another page of my notes.
examples.zh: 我们起飞前遇上了「地面延误」，我又看完了一页笔记。

examples.en: The ground delay ended while we were still waiting near the gate to board.
examples.zh: 我们在登机口附近候机时，「起飞前地面延误」结束了。

words.enDefinition: a wait on the ground during which passengers cannot leave the plane

examples.en: I read several more pages during the tarmac delay before our flight finally took off.
examples.zh: 飞机终于起飞前遇上「不能下机的地面延误」，我又读了几页书。

examples.en: After landing, a tarmac delay meant we stayed on the plane while waiting for a gate.
examples.zh: 着陆后遇到「不能下机的地面延误」，我们留在飞机上等空出的登机口。

words.enDefinition: a repeated flight path used while an aircraft waits to proceed

examples.en: The captain said we were in a holding pattern above the coast before landing.
examples.zh: 机长说，着陆前我们正在海岸上方「空中盘旋等待」。

examples.en: We stayed in a holding pattern long enough for me to finish the article.
examples.zh: 我们的「空中盘旋等待」持续了一阵，我都把文章读完了。

words.enDefinition: an announcement that boarding has temporarily stopped

examples.en: The screen said 'Boarding suspended' while an agent spoke to the crew by the door.
examples.zh: 工作人员在门旁和机组人员说话时，屏幕显示「暂停登机」。

examples.en: I saw 'Boarding suspended' when I returned from filling my water bottle near the gate.
examples.zh: 我在登机口附近灌完水回来时，看见提示「暂停登机」。

words.enDefinition: an aircraft parking position away from the terminal building

examples.en: We parked at a remote stand, and a bus took us to the terminal.
examples.zh: 飞机停在「远机位」，一辆巴士把我们送到航站楼。

examples.en: The plane arrived at a remote stand after the gates near arrivals filled up.
examples.zh: 到达区附近的登机口停满后，飞机停到了一个「远机位」。

collocations: a bus from a remote stand

words.zhGloss: 暂未公布新的出发时间
words.enDefinition: says the airline has not announced a revised departure time
acceptedZhAnswers: 暂未公布新的出发时间

examples.en: There was no new departure time when I checked the app after speaking to my friend.
examples.zh: 我和朋友聊完后查看应用，发现「暂未公布新的出发时间」。

examples.en: The announcement said there was no new departure time while the aircraft was being checked.
examples.zh: 广播说飞机正在检查，「暂未公布新的出发时间」。

collocations: a notice saying no new departure time

words.enDefinition: a notification about a change or update to a flight

examples.en: I got a flight status alert while I was on the bus to the airport.
examples.zh: 我坐公交去机场时收到一条「航班状态提醒」。

examples.en: The flight status alert showed a new gate before the information screen had updated.
examples.zh: 信息屏还没更新，「航班状态提醒」就已经显示了新的登机口。

words.enDefinition: make a replacement booking when your original flight changes

examples.en: I needed to rebook a flight after the airline cancelled our original departure.
examples.zh: 航空公司取消了我们原定的航班后，我需要「改订另一班飞机」。

examples.en: The agent helped me rebook a flight that would get me home before class.
examples.zh: 工作人员帮我「改订另一班飞机」，这样我能在上课前到家。

words.enDefinition: a replacement flight booking made automatically by the airline

examples.en: The app offered automatic rebooking after my connection was cancelled while we were still airborne.
examples.zh: 我们还在空中时，转乘航班被取消了，应用上出现了「自动改订航班」的选项。

examples.en: I checked the automatic rebooking because the new flight arrived at a different airport.
examples.zh: 新航班到的是另一个机场，我就核对了「自动改订航班」的结果。

words.enDefinition: a list of passengers waiting for a seat to become available

examples.en: I joined the standby list after the agent said the next flight was full.
examples.zh: 工作人员说下一趟航班满了，我就上了「候补名单」。

examples.en: The standby list was visible on a small screen beside the airline desk.
examples.zh: 航空公司柜台旁的小屏幕能看到「候补名单」。

collocations: put someone on the standby list
check your place on the standby list

words.enDefinition: a place secured on a flight without waiting for an opening

examples.en: I didn't have a confirmed seat on the earlier flight, so I waited downstairs.
examples.zh: 早一趟航班上我还没有「已确认的座位」，所以在楼下等着。

examples.en: The airline sent an update when I finally had a confirmed seat on the replacement flight.
examples.zh: 我终于拿到替代航班上「已确认的座位」时，航空公司发来了更新消息。

words.enDefinition: the earliest later flight that has a seat available

examples.en: The agent found the next available flight, which departed shortly after lunch the following day.
examples.zh: 工作人员找到了「下一班有位的航班」，第二天午饭后不久出发。

examples.en: I asked for the next available flight because my term started on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我的学期周一早上开始，所以我问能不能坐「下一班有位的航班」。

words.zhGloss: 把我的行程改为经某地转机
words.enDefinition: asks to change your travel route through a different airport
acceptedZhAnswers: 把我的行程改为经某地转机

examples.en: Could you reroute me via another airport if this connection will not be possible?
examples.zh: 要是这次转机赶不上，能「把我的行程改为经另一个机场转机」吗？

examples.en: The agent offered to reroute me via Dublin after the second flight was cancelled.
examples.zh: 第二趟航班取消后，工作人员提出「把我的行程改为经都柏林转机」。

collocations: can you reroute me via another airport?
would it be possible to reroute me via Boston?
ask the airline to reroute me via another city

words.enDefinition: a different flight arranged in place of the original one

examples.en: The replacement flight went to the same city but left from a different terminal.
examples.zh: 「替代航班」还是飞往同一个城市，但从另一座航站楼出发。

examples.en: I told my friend the replacement flight would arrive too late for our bus.
examples.zh: 我告诉朋友，「替代航班」到得太晚，我们赶不上那班公交。

words.enDefinition: a confirmation that a changed booking has been made

examples.en: I waited for rebooking confirmation before making any changes to my train ticket home.
examples.zh: 我等收到「改订航班确认通知」后，才改了回家的火车票。

examples.en: The rebooking confirmation showed the new arrival airport below the updated flight number.
examples.zh: 「改订航班确认通知」在新的航班号下方列出了新的到达机场。

words.enDefinition: a replacement ticket issued after an existing booking is changed

examples.en: I downloaded the reissued ticket so I could check the new dates without internet access.
examples.zh: 我下载了「重新出票后的机票」，这样没网也能查新的日期。

examples.en: The reissued ticket arrived shortly after I agreed to travel the next morning instead.
examples.zh: 我同意改成第二天早上出发后不久，就收到了「重新出票后的机票」。

words.enDefinition: value with an airline that can be applied to a future booking

examples.en: The app showed my flight credit when I started searching for dates during the break.
examples.zh: 我开始查假期可飞的日期时，应用显示了我的「机票抵用余额」。

examples.en: I checked whether my flight credit was listed under the original booking in the app.
examples.zh: 我查了「机票抵用余额」是否列在应用里的原预订下面。

words.enDefinition: a written record from an airline confirming a delay

examples.en: I requested a flight delay confirmation because I was late for a scheduled training session.
examples.zh: 因为我没能按时到培训课，我申请了一份「航班延误证明」。

examples.en: The airline emailed a flight delay confirmation shortly after we landed in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们下午着陆后不久，航空公司发邮件给了一份「航班延误证明」。

words.enDefinition: a counter where an airline helps passengers with travel issues

examples.en: I went to the airline service desk after the airport screen showed my flight had changed.
examples.zh: 机场信息屏显示航班变更后，我去了「航空公司服务柜台」。

examples.en: The line at the airline service desk moved quickly once a second agent arrived.
examples.zh: 第二位工作人员来了以后，「航空公司服务柜台」的队伍走得很快。

collocations: go to the airline service desk
queue at the airline service desk
ask at the airline service desk

words.enDefinition: circumstances connected with running the airline's service

examples.en: The announcement said the flight was delayed for operational reasons and gave no further details.
examples.zh: 广播说航班「因运营原因」延误，没给更多细节。

examples.en: The airline cited operational reasons when it moved our departure to the next morning.
examples.zh: 航空公司把出发改到次日早上，说是因为「航班运营原因」。

words.enDefinition: whether enough crew members are available to operate a flight

examples.en: The revised departure time depended on crew availability, according to the announcement at the gate.
examples.zh: 登机口广播说，新的出发时间取决于「机组人员能否到位」。

examples.en: The airline mentioned crew availability before confirming that our flight could leave that evening.
examples.zh: 航空公司先提到了「机组人员能否到位」，之后才确认我们能当天晚上出发。

collocations: a change due to crew availability

words.enDefinition: move back to the boarding gate after leaving it

examples.en: The captain announced that we needed to return to the gate for another check.
examples.zh: 机长广播说，「飞机要返回登机口」再做一次检查。

examples.en: Our plane had to return to the gate before it could depart that evening.
examples.zh: 我们的「飞机不得不返回登机口」，后来才能在当晚出发。

collocations: need to return to the gate
decide to return to the gate
ask the aircraft to return to the gate

words.enDefinition: fly back to the airport where the flight began

examples.en: We had to return to the departure airport after the crew announced a change of plan.
examples.zh: 机组广播说计划有变，我们的「飞机折返出发机场」。

examples.en: The captain said we would return to the departure airport instead of continuing south.
examples.zh: 机长说「飞机将折返出发机场」，原定往南的行程中止。

collocations: decide to return to the departure airport
have to return to the departure airport
ask why the plane will return to the departure airport

words.enDefinition: a flight with more bookings than seats available

examples.en: The agent said it was an overbooked flight and asked us to wait nearby.
examples.zh: 工作人员说这是「超售的航班」，请我们在附近等待。

examples.en: I heard about the overbooked flight when the airline made an announcement at the gate.
examples.zh: 航空公司在登机口广播时，我才知道那是「超售的航班」。

collocations: an announcement about an overbooked flight

words.enDefinition: refused permission to board a flight

examples.en: The traveler was denied boarding and went to the airline desk to ask what happened.
examples.zh: 这位旅客「被拒绝登机」，就去航空公司柜台问发生了什么。

examples.en: I asked why I was denied boarding after the agent told me to step aside.
examples.zh: 工作人员让我先站到一边，我问自己为什么「被拒绝登机」。

collocations: ask why you were denied boarding

words.enDefinition: asks whether another flight leaves at a later time

examples.en: Is there a later flight tonight if I can't reach the airport in time?
examples.zh: 如果我赶不到机场，今晚「还有更晚的航班吗」？

examples.en: Is there a later flight that still reaches the same airport before the buses stop running?
examples.zh: 「还有更晚的航班吗」？我想在公交停运前到达同一个机场。

collocations: is there a later flight today?
is there a later flight from this airport?
after this one, is there a later flight?

words.enDefinition: a moving belt where arriving passengers collect checked bags

examples.en: I stood by the baggage carousel while my flatmate went to check the flight number.
examples.zh: 室友去核对航班号时，我站在「行李转盘」旁等着。

examples.en: The baggage carousel stopped before I saw the suitcase I had checked that morning.
examples.zh: 「行李转盘」停了，我还没看到早上托运的箱子。

words.enDefinition: the arrivals area where passengers collect their checked bags

examples.en: We walked to baggage claim after leaving the plane and followed the signs for our flight.
examples.zh: 下飞机后我们走到「行李提取区」，跟着自己航班的指示牌走。

examples.en: I called my friend from baggage claim because our suitcases were taking a while.
examples.zh: 箱子要等一阵，我在「行李提取区」给朋友打了电话。

words.enDefinition: the arrivals location for collecting large checked items

examples.en: My instrument case came out at oversized baggage collection on the far side of arrivals.
examples.zh: 我的乐器盒在到达大厅远端的「超大件行李领取处」出来了。

examples.en: I asked where oversized baggage collection was because my suitcase had already appeared on the belt.
examples.zh: 我的箱子已经上了转盘，我就问「超大件行李领取处」在哪儿。

collocations: the sign for oversized baggage collection

words.enDefinition: a counter staffed to help with missing or damaged bags

examples.en: I went to the baggage services desk after the belt stopped and my bag hadn't appeared.
examples.zh: 转盘停了还没看到我的包，我就去了「行李服务柜台」。

examples.en: The agent at the baggage services desk asked which flight I had arrived on.
examples.zh: 「行李服务柜台」的工作人员问我是坐哪趟航班到的。

collocations: go to the baggage services desk
ask at the baggage services desk
an agent at the baggage services desk

words.zhGloss: 本航班行李传送已结束
words.enDefinition: a status saying the routine unloading of baggage from a flight has finished
acceptedZhAnswers: 本航班行李传送已结束

examples.en: The screen said 'Baggage delivery complete,' but I was still waiting for my suitcase.
examples.zh: 信息屏显示「本航班行李传送已结束」，可我还在等箱子。

examples.en: I checked our flight number again when 'Baggage delivery complete' appeared beside the carousel.
examples.zh: 转盘旁显示「本航班行李传送已结束」后，我又核对了一遍航班号。

collocations: a screen saying baggage delivery complete
the display shows baggage delivery complete
wait until it says baggage delivery complete

words.enDefinition: checked luggage that has not reached the traveler at the expected time

examples.en: I asked about my delayed baggage because I had another trip the following morning.
examples.zh: 我第二天早上还有一趟行程，所以问了问「延迟到达的托运行李」。

examples.en: The airline sent an update about our delayed baggage while we waited for the bus.
examples.zh: 等公交时，航空公司发来了「延迟到达的托运行李」的最新消息。

words.enDefinition: checked luggage that the airline cannot locate

examples.en: The airline asked me to describe my lost baggage and check the contact number.
examples.zh: 航空公司请我描述「遗失的托运行李」，并确认联系电话。

examples.en: They sent another message about the lost baggage after checking a different arrival airport.
examples.zh: 核查了另一个到达机场后，他们又发来了关于「遗失的托运行李」的消息。

words.enDefinition: checked luggage returned with physical damage

examples.en: I showed the agent my damaged baggage because one of the suitcase wheels was missing.
examples.zh: 我的箱子少了一个轮子，所以我把「受损的托运行李」给工作人员看。

examples.en: The representative asked whether I had photos of the damaged baggage taken after arrival.
examples.zh: 工作人员问我有没有到达后拍的「受损的托运行李」的照片。

words.enDefinition: luggage that nobody has collected after it was unloaded

examples.en: The staff took the unclaimed baggage off the belt after our flight finished unloading.
examples.zh: 我们航班的行李全部卸下后，工作人员把「无人领取的行李」从传送带上拿走了。

examples.en: The agent checked a list of unclaimed baggage when I described my missing suitcase.
examples.zh: 我描述没收到的箱子时，工作人员查了「无人领取的行李」清单。

words.enDefinition: the airline's search to locate luggage that has not arrived

examples.en: The agent started baggage tracing after I gave her the number from my receipt.
examples.zh: 我把凭条上的号码报给工作人员后，她开始「查找追踪行李」。

examples.en: A team responsible for baggage tracing emailed to ask for a photo of the suitcase.
examples.zh: 负责「行李查找追踪」的团队发来邮件，要一张箱子的照片。

collocations: check the progress of baggage tracing

words.enDefinition: a code identifying an airline's search record for a missing bag

examples.en: I wrote down my baggage tracing reference before leaving the airport for my residence.
examples.zh: 离开机场去宿舍前，我记下了「行李查找编号」。

examples.en: The agent needed the baggage tracing reference to find my report on her screen.
examples.zh: 工作人员需要「行李查找编号」，才能在她的屏幕上找到我的报告。

collocations: ask for the baggage tracing reference

words.enDefinition: an airline report recording luggage that is missing, delayed, or damaged

examples.en: I received a property irregularity report after explaining that my suitcase never reached the carousel.
examples.zh: 我说了自己的箱子始终没出现在转盘上，随后收到了一份「行李异常报告」。

examples.en: The agent checked my property irregularity report before updating the address on the baggage record.
examples.zh: 工作人员先查看了我的「行李异常报告」，再更新行李记录上的地址。

collocations: the reference on a property irregularity report

words.enDefinition: a status showing staff are still trying to locate a bag

examples.en: The page still showed baggage search in progress when I got back to campus.
examples.zh: 我回到学校时，页面仍显示「行李仍在查找中」。

examples.en: I could see baggage search in progress but there was no updated arrival time.
examples.zh: 我能看到「行李仍在查找中」，但没有新的预计到达时间。

collocations: a baggage search in progress status
the app says baggage search in progress

words.enDefinition: the number used to identify an individual checked bag

examples.en: I found the baggage tag number on the small receipt I got at check-in.
examples.zh: 我在值机时拿到的小凭条上找到了「托运行李标签号码」。

examples.en: The agent asked me to read out the baggage tag number from my receipt.
examples.zh: 工作人员请我念出凭条上的「托运行李标签号码」。

collocations: give the agent a baggage tag number

words.enDefinition: details such as size or color used to identify luggage

examples.en: My luggage description included a blue strap and a small white sticker near the handle.
examples.zh: 我的「行李外观描述」写了蓝色绑带，提手旁边还有一张小白贴纸。

examples.en: I updated the luggage description after finding a photo from our previous trip.
examples.zh: 找到上次旅行时拍的照片后，我更新了「行李外观描述」。

collocations: add details to a luggage description

words.zhGloss: 能辨认行李的独特标记
words.enDefinition: unusual visible features that help identify a bag
acceptedZhAnswers: 能辨认行李的独特标记

examples.en: The agent asked about distinctive markings, so I mentioned the yellow tape near the handle.
examples.zh: 工作人员问有没有「能辨认行李的独特标记」，我就提到提手旁边的黄胶带。

examples.en: I added distinctive markings to the report because three bags looked almost the same.
examples.zh: 三个包看起来几乎一模一样，所以我在报告里补充了「独特标记」。

words.enDefinition: the most recent place where a bag was known to be

examples.en: The last known location of my bag was the airport where I changed planes.
examples.zh: 我的包「最后一次确认的位置」是我换飞机的机场。

examples.en: The agent checked the last known location before asking another airport to look for it.
examples.zh: 工作人员先查了「最后一次确认的位置」，再请另一个机场帮忙找。

words.zhGloss: 最近一次行李扫描记录
words.enDefinition: the latest recorded scan of a checked bag's tag
acceptedZhAnswers: 最近一次行李扫描记录

examples.en: The last baggage scan was recorded before my first flight left for the transfer airport.
examples.zh: 第一趟航班飞往转机机场前就有了「最近一次行李扫描记录」。

examples.en: I asked the agent whether the last baggage scan showed a time as well.
examples.zh: 我问工作人员，「最近一次行李扫描记录」是不是也显示时间。

collocations: look up the last baggage scan

words.enDefinition: new information about the progress of locating or returning a bag

examples.en: I got a baggage status update while I was unpacking the things from my backpack.
examples.zh: 我从背包里拿东西时，收到了一条「行李查找进展通知」。

examples.en: The baggage status update said the bag had finally reached the airport near campus.
examples.zh: 「行李查找进展通知」说，包终于到了学校附近的机场。

collocations: ask for a baggage status update

words.enDefinition: check where your checked bag is or what has happened to it

examples.en: I used the airline's app to track my bag while waiting at the transfer airport.
examples.zh: 在转机机场等候时，我用航空公司的应用「查看我的行李去向」。

examples.en: Could you show me how to track my bag from the baggage details screen?
examples.zh: 能教我怎么在行李详情页面「查看我的行李去向」吗？

collocations: use the app to track my bag
ask someone to track my bag
where can I track my bag?

words.expression: where can I report a missing bag
words.lemma: where can i report a missing bag
words.zhGloss: 没收到行李该去哪儿报备
words.enDefinition: asks where to notify the airline about a bag that has not arrived
acceptedZhAnswers: 没收到行李该去哪儿报备
acceptedEnVariants: where can I report a missing bag

examples.en: Where can I report a missing bag now that the carousel has stopped running?
examples.zh: 行李转盘已经停了，「没收到行李该去哪儿报备」？

examples.en: Where can I report a missing bag if the arrivals desk is already closed?
examples.zh: 如果到达区的服务台已经关了，「没收到行李该去哪儿报备」？

collocations: excuse me, where can I report a missing bag?
where can I report a missing bag at this airport?
now that the belt has stopped, where can I report a missing bag?

words.enDefinition: says your checked bag has not appeared on the belt

examples.en: My bag hasn't come out, but all the other students already have their suitcases.
examples.zh: 「我的行李还没出来」，但其他同学都已经拿到箱子了。

examples.en: My bag hasn't come out on this belt, although the screen shows my flight.
examples.zh: 屏幕显示的是我这趟航班，可「我的行李还没从这个转盘出来」。

collocations: my bag hasn't come out yet
my bag hasn't come out on this belt
it looks like my bag hasn't come out

words.expression: is my bag on the next flight
words.lemma: is my bag on the next flight
words.zhGloss: 我的行李在下一趟航班上吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether the bag is being sent on the next flight
acceptedZhAnswers: 我的行李在下一趟航班上吗
acceptedEnVariants: is my bag on the next flight

examples.en: Is my bag on the next flight from the airport where I changed planes?
examples.zh: 「我的行李在下一趟航班上吗」？是从我换飞机的机场飞过来的那趟。

examples.en: Is my bag on the next flight to this airport or still waiting somewhere?
examples.zh: 「我的行李在飞来这个机场的下一趟航班上吗」，还是仍在别处等着？

collocations: is my bag on the next flight from there?
can you check, is my bag on the next flight?
is my bag on the next flight to this airport?

words.expression: my bag was sent to the wrong airport
words.lemma: my bag was sent to the wrong airport
words.zhGloss: 我的行李被送错机场了
words.enDefinition: reports that the bag was routed to a different airport by mistake
acceptedZhAnswers: 我的行李被送错机场了
acceptedEnVariants: my bag was sent to the wrong airport

examples.en: The agent said my bag was sent to the wrong airport after our transfer.
examples.zh: 工作人员说，转机后「我的行李被送错机场了」。

examples.en: It looks like my bag was sent to the wrong airport according to the tracking page.
examples.zh: 从追踪页面看，好像「我的行李被送错机场了」。

collocations: it looks like my bag was sent to the wrong airport
the airline says my bag was sent to the wrong airport
I think my bag was sent to the wrong airport

words.enDefinition: sending delayed baggage onward to the intended airport or recipient

examples.en: The airline arranged baggage forwarding after locating the bag at the airport where I transferred.
examples.zh: 航空公司在我转机的机场找到了包，随后安排「延误行李再次转运」。

examples.en: I saw a note about baggage forwarding beside the new airport on the status page.
examples.zh: 我在状态页面的新机场名称旁边看到一条「延误行李再次转运」的说明。

words.enDefinition: arrange for the bag to be brought to your address

examples.en: Could I have my bag delivered to my residence once it reaches this airport?
examples.zh: 行李到了这个机场之后，能「让人把行李送到我的宿舍」吗？

examples.en: I asked whether I could have my bag delivered after I moved to another address.
examples.zh: 我问换了住址之后，能不能「让人把行李送过来」。

collocations: can I have my bag delivered?
have my bag delivered to my residence
ask to have my bag delivered

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a previously missing bag has been found

examples.en: The app displayed 'Bag located' just before the baggage team emailed me about delivery.
examples.zh: 行李小组发邮件联系我送件前，应用显示了「已找到行李」。

examples.en: I saw 'Bag located' on the status page, but it hadn't reached the airport yet.
examples.zh: 我在状态页面看到「已找到行李」，不过它还没到机场。

words.expression: I left my bag on the plane
words.lemma: i left my bag on the plane
words.enDefinition: reports that a bag was forgotten inside the aircraft
acceptedEnVariants: I left my bag on the plane

examples.en: I left my bag on the plane, and my notebook is inside the front pocket.
examples.zh: 「我把包落在飞机上了」，我的笔记本就在前袋里。

examples.en: I think I left my bag on the plane when our group got off.
examples.zh: 我们小组下飞机时，「我好像把包落在飞机上了」。

collocations: I think I left my bag on the plane
I left my bag on the plane after landing
tell the agent I left my bag on the plane

words.expression: which belt is our baggage on
words.lemma: which belt is our baggage on
words.zhGloss: 我们的行李在哪个转盘
words.enDefinition: asks which carousel is receiving bags from your flight
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们的行李在哪个转盘
acceptedEnVariants: which belt is our baggage on

examples.en: Which belt is our baggage on now that two more flights have arrived here?
examples.zh: 现在这里又到了两趟航班，「我们的行李在哪个转盘」？

examples.en: The display has changed, so which belt is our baggage on for this flight?
examples.zh: 显示屏变了，「我们这班的行李在哪个转盘」？

collocations: which belt is our baggage on now?
excuse me, which belt is our baggage on?
the screen changed, which belt is our baggage on?
